g.text: 9 · Business logic can and should be centralized
The approval rule lives only in the orchestrator's prompt; a handoff skips it, and 2,160 EUR is paid unapproved.
Believe business logic can be centralized, and:
· one rule, checked where users start: the browser
Code puts the server on every request's path.
Fix: check the rule on purpose in every tier: the
browser for speed, server and database to enforce it.
Book 6 rooms at the Garden Inn
CH-001: 2,160 EUR paid; no one was asked to approve it
(1) the rule lives only in the orchestrator's instructions
(2) the Hotel agent hands off to the Payment agent
(3) the Payment agent pays what the handoff names
Fix: Charge runs the rule for every caller and holds
the payment (AR-001); the instructions restate the rule.
